description: This file contains unit tests for the NiaTheme composable in an Android Jetpack Compose project. It verifies that the theme provides correct color schemes, gradient colors, background themes, and tint themes under various configurations of dark mode, dynamic theming, and Android-specific themes.

classes.name: ThemeTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that runs various tests to verify the behavior of NiaTheme under different theme configurations.
